title: Parkview Health Databricks Healthcare Data Platform Executive Briefing

hero.headline: Unified healthcare data, ready for decisions.
hero.lede: Turning Parkview’s enterprise data into governed insight, predictive intelligence, and AI-enabled workflow through a modern Databricks-centered platform.

story_layers.title: Data foundations
story_layers.summary: System, streaming, and unstructured data are organized into governed healthcare domains.

story_layers.title: Consumption layer & capabilities
story_layers.summary: Certified metrics, normalized views, transaction detail, interop, forecast inputs, and AI features make the platform reusable.

story_layers.title: Enabled outcomes
story_layers.summary: Rapid insight, predictive analytics, and AI-enabled workflows are delivered through the right experiences.

platform_map.headline: A platform-centric architecture accelerates innovation while strengthening enterprise-wide data & AI governance.

foundations.title: Core Application System Data
foundations.summary: Ingest, normalize, and cross-aggregate data across EHR, scheduling, pharmacy, lab, finance, ERP, supply chain, HRIS, and revenue cycle applications to create a shared operating view.

foundations.title: Streaming Data
foundations.summary: Enable near-real-time event feeds that support time-sensitive operational visibility, model freshness, care coordination, and in-workflow actions.

foundations.title: Unstructured Data
foundations.summary: Convert scans, faxes, reports, clinical notes, images, transcripts, and machine-generated files into searchable, structured, AI-ready information.

capabilities.title: Certified Metrics
capabilities.business_value: One version of the truth for margin, access, volume, quality, and post-acquisition performance conversations.

capabilities.title: Normalized Views
capabilities.business_value: Faster analysis without rebuilding joins and definitions for every initiative.

capabilities.title: Transaction Detail
capabilities.business_value: Supports reconciliation, auditability, and root-cause analysis when a metric changes.

capabilities.title: Forecast / Budget Inputs
capabilities.business_value: Better planning confidence for staffing, access, service-line growth, supply utilization, and financial performance.

capabilities.title: Interoperability
capabilities.business_value: Connects insights to the systems and workflows where decisions are made.

capabilities.title: Reusable AI Features
capabilities.business_value: Accelerates responsible AI adoption while preserving security, lineage, and performance monitoring.

demos.title: Ambient Clinical Documentation
demos.summary: Turns a visit conversation into a sourced draft note, suggests supported E&M and diagnosis codes, and keeps clinician attestation at the center of the workflow.

demos.title: Clinical Coding & CDI Copilot
demos.summary: Abstracts charts into supported codes, surfaces compliant CDI opportunities, and models DRG and reimbursement impact before coder attestation.

demos.title: Prior Authorization Automation
demos.summary: Checks whether authorization is required, maps clinical evidence to payer criteria, flags missing documentation, and assembles a staff-reviewed submission packet.

demos.title: Denial Management & Appeals
demos.summary: Ranks denials by recoverable value and overturn likelihood, root-causes each event, and drafts evidence-backed appeal content for specialist review.

demos.title: Patient Access & Referral Leakage
demos.summary: Ranks referrals by leakage risk and value, verifies eligibility, estimates patient cost, and helps staff match patients to the right in-network slot.

demos.title: Hospital Operations Command Center
demos.providerAudience: house supervisors, bed managers, and ED / OR charge nurses
demos.summary: Unifies bed, ED, OR, and discharge signals into a current operating view with short-horizon forecasts and operator-owned capacity recommendations.

demos.title: Multi-Site Eye-Care Performance Analytics
demos.summary: Rolls site, region, and group performance into one view, pinpoints volume and provider-capacity gaps, and ranks next-best actions by opportunity.
